info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings API provides access to the ratings associated with various deliveries in the food delivery service. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve detailed insights into customer satisfaction based on delivery ratings. This information is essential for businesses looking to enhance service quality and menu offerings. Common use cases include analyzing customer feedback and performance metrics to support decision-making and strategy development. Typical consumers of this API might be data analysts, product managers, or customer experience teams.

get.description: Fetch the rating for a specific delivery based on predefined criteria. This endpoint allows users to access feedback metrics that are essential for evaluating delivery performance.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the rating of deliveries. This request is used to evaluate the performance and customer satisfaction regarding a specific delivery.
